title.en: Defending Canada in the War of 1812
title.fr: La défense du Canada pendant la guerre de 1812

text.en: Canadian volunteers and First Nations helped British soldiers defend Canada. Among the First Nations were the Shawnee, led by Chief Tecumseh.
text.fr: Des volontaires canadiens et des Premières Nations ont aidé les soldats britanniques à défendre le Canada. Parmi ces Premières Nations, il y avait les Shawnees, dirigés par le chef Tecumseh.

source.quote: Canadian volunteers and First Nations, including Shawnee led by Chief Tecumseh, supported British soldiers in Canada’s defence.

verification.evidence: Canadian volunteers and First Nations, including Shawnee led by Chief Tecumseh, supported British soldiers in Canada’s defence.

text.en: Major-General Sir Isaac Brock took Detroit. Later he was killed at Queenston Heights, near Niagara Falls, while fighting off an American attack. The Americans lost that battle.
text.fr: Le major-général sir Isaac Brock s'est emparé de Détroit. Plus tard, il a été tué à Queenston Heights, près des chutes Niagara, en repoussant une attaque américaine. Les Américains ont perdu cette bataille.

source.quote: Major-General Sir Isaac Brock captured Detroit but was killed while defending against an American attack at Queenston Heights, near Niagara Falls, a battle the Americans lost.

verification.evidence: Major-General Sir Isaac Brock captured Detroit but was killed while defending against an American attack at Queenston Heights, near Niagara Falls, a battle the Americans lost.

text.en: At Châteauguay, south of Montreal, an American force of 4,000 invaders was driven back.
text.fr: À Châteauguay, au sud de Montréal, une force américaine de 4 000 envahisseurs a été repoussée.

source.quote: back 4,000 American invaders at Châteauguay, south of Montreal.

verification.evidence: In 1813, Lieutenant-Colonel Charles de Salaberry and 460 soldiers, mostly French Canadiens, turned back 4,000 American invaders at Châteauguay, south of Montreal.

text.en: In 1813, American troops burned Government House and the Parliament Buildings in York, the town that is now Toronto.
text.fr: En 1813, les troupes américaines ont incendié la résidence du gouverneur et les édifices du Parlement à York, la ville qui est aujourd'hui Toronto.

source.quote: In 1813 the Americans burned Government House and the Parliament Buildings in York (now Toronto).

verification.evidence: In 1813 the Americans burned Government House and the Parliament Buildings in York (now Toronto).

text.en: Britain paid for an expensive system of defences in Canada. It included Fort Henry in Kingston, a naval drydock in Halifax, and the Citadels in Québec City and Halifax. Many people visit these historic sites today.
text.fr: La Grande-Bretagne a payé un coûteux réseau de défense au Canada. Il comprenait le fort Henry à Kingston, une cale sèche navale à Halifax, et les citadelles de Québec et d'Halifax. Beaucoup de gens visitent ces lieux historiques aujourd'hui.

source.quote: The British paid for a costly Canadian defence system, including the Citadels at Halifax and Québec City, the naval drydock at Halifax and Fort Henry at Kingston—today popular historic sites.

verification.evidence: The British paid for a costly Canadian defence system, including the Citadels at Halifax and Québec City, the naval drydock at Halifax and Fort Henry at Kingston—today popular historic sites.

text.en: The War of 1812 made sure that Canada stayed independent of the United States. The border between the two countries today is partly a result of that war.
text.fr: La guerre de 1812 a fait en sorte que le Canada reste indépendant des États-Unis. La frontière actuelle entre les deux pays découle en partie de cette guerre.

source.quote: The present-day Canada-U.S.A. border is partly an outcome of the War of 1812, which ensured that Canada would remain independent of the United States.

verification.evidence: The present-day Canada-U.S.A. border is partly an outcome of the War of 1812, which ensured that Canada would remain independent of the United States.
